text: Liekki Redlands: Area 3
Vatran the Crimson Dragon
Pelulu
Zianga
Vatran the Crimson Dragon
BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Vatran the Crimson Dragon!!
Whoa, this place is creepy~!\nEven a veteran like me who's been through\ncountless battles is getting cold feet~!
The bones scattered around here must belong to\nVatran's victims. This isn't a pleasant sight,\nespecially when we're about to face him.
Y-you go first~!
My goshhhh~!! A-A dragonnn~!!
I-is it Vatran the Crimson Dragon?!
You really let your guard down, didn't you?\nI could smell you the moment you set foot on this\nmountain. You can't hide your presence from me.
Bwahahaha...did the villagers send you here?\nOr perhaps...
You're after the flames of hell that never\ngo out...Are you here to steal the "Ancient\nEternal Charcoal" that runs through my veins?
B-both!!
Also, a little fella from another world asked for\nour help!!
Bwahahaha...I admire your courage. Most ordinary\nfolk who step into Liekki Redlands would be burnt\nto a crisp the moment they stand before me.
What? Really?
Are the gods protecting you?\nI see...They've taken a liking to you. I don't\nlike that!
When did we gain the gods' protection?
Fire protection...Could it be Flammel?
A dragon shouldn't act like this!
Stop picking on the weak!
Yeah! A mighty legendary dragon like you,\nattacking powerless people? Don't you feel\nashamed?!
The adventurer's right!\nYou're hurting powerless people for no reason!\nIs that what a mighty dragon does?!
I don't know, and there's no need for me to know.\nI won't be taken in by your talk of peace,\ncoexistence, and other meaningless drivel, humans.
Bwahahaha...I see. So that's how it is...
W-what?
The foundations of the world are crumbling.\nDragon and human nature is broken as a new order\nis about to be born...
Right? My racing heart and burning blood...\nThey are proof that I resonate with the new\ndraconic power.
...What's this dragon talking about?
Hey, watch yourself!
Hey, what's wrong with you?! Get ready to fight!
Aha, you seem to know what's going on.\nIs this someone's doing? If so, who? And what's\ntheir purpose?
Watching the world from above like this...\nIt's just like the work of a god, isn't it?
Hey, what happened to you?!
Hey, pull yourself together!!
Bwahahaha...Well, there's nothing complicated\nbetween us. All you need to do is defeat me, and\neverything will be settled...
Oh, I've been defeated...\nBut why? Why did I have to end up like this...
Yay~!!
Hahaha, we managed to beat him!!
When you just stood there like a statue in front\nof the dragon, I thought we were done for~!\nBut whatever, we won, and that's all that matters!
All right!\nThis must be the "Ancient Eternal Charcoal",\nright?!
Wait a sec...\nDoesn't this jewel look familiar?
Really?\nWell, who cares. As long as it's real, it's all\ngood!
Yeah, you're right!
Taking this to Freedos will settle everything!\nKipina will be happy, and we've saved everyone who\nwas hurt by the Crimson Dragon. Perfect!
All right! Let's go back to Kipina first!
